span.span: We specialize in the engineering, automation, and maintenance of conveyor belt systems, delivering reliable, high-performance solutions that optimize material handling and maximize operational efficiency.

li.span: Custom automation powered by high-performance PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA delivering precise speed control, tracking, and sorting for seamless conveyor operation.
Our conveyor systems are designed to integrate seamlessly into your Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). Equipped with smart sensors and open communication protocols.
Workflow analysis to eliminate bottlenecks, jams, and buffering issues, boosting throughput while reducing belt wear, downtime, and energy costs.
Seamless Industry 4.0 integration with robotic cells, packaging stations, AS/RS, and smart sensors for a unified material handling ecosystem.
Full-service feasibility studies and safety audits (CE/OSHA compliance, e-stops, risk assessments) to guarantee maximum operational safety and compliance.

div.class: o_colored_level border col-lg-6 order-lg-0 pt16 rounded

li.span: We program reliable PLC systems for conveyor lines, combining zero-pressure accumulation, motion control, and intuitive HMIs to optimize material throughput
We integrate robots and cobots for automated sorting, loading, and palletizing, improving speed, accuracy, and continuous product flow.
We design and build custom control cabinets optimized for conveyor systems, ensuring robust power distribution and seamless fieldbus integration.
We automate manual sorting and conveyance using smart sensors, pneumatic diverters, and VFDs to ensure precise material tracking and routing.
We upgrade legacy conveyor controls and obsolete drive systems to boost efficiency and reliability with minimal operational downtime.

div.class: o_colored_level col-lg-6 order-lg-0 border pt16 rounded

li.span: We execute scheduled inspections, belt tracking, and drive adjustments based on operating cycles to prevent costly line stoppages.
We use vibration, thermal, and sensor data to detect roller wear and belt stretch early, fixing issues before a breakdown occurs.
We streamline spare parts inventory, belt replacement schedules, and service workflows to maximize uptime while reducing maintenance costs.
We analyze belt wear, splice failures, and bottleneck points to implement targeted modifications that extend conveyor lifespan.
We deliver fast technical support, expert troubleshooting, and on-site servicing throughout your system’s lifecycle to keep your lines running.
